title: Test Mode: Safe Practice Money
tagline: Practice freely knowing no real money moves until you connect a real provider.
audience: first-time users afraid of losing money
objectives: Understand how sample money powers safe practice without risk
Create a capped practice card for everyday testing
Freeze or close cards instantly to control spending
Identify the test-mode banner before connecting a real provider

analogy.title: Learning to Fly in a Simulator
analogy.story: Imagine learning to fly in a flight simulator before touching a real plane. You get play money instead of real cash, so every takeoff and landing is safe to practice. Test mode works the same way for your cards. Your sample balance and sample cards let you try spending, freezing, and reviewing history without any real money moving. You can make mistakes, learn the controls, and build confidence calmly. When you are ready, you will connect a real card provider and leave the simulator behind.

mapping.everydayThing: play money in a board game
practice flights logged in a simulator
simulator doors that never open to a real runway

pitch30Seconds: Welcome to Test Mode, your safe practice space. Nothing here moves real money. You start with sample money and create capped practice cards to try everyday spending. Freeze, unfreeze, or close instantly, then check your history to see charges and declines clearly. You will always see a test-mode banner so you know you are still in demo. Practice as much as you need, build confidence calmly, and only when ready, connect your real card provider.

coreIdeas.plainWords: Demo money added to your account for practice. You can add, spend, and track it without touching your bank.
Practice cards that act like real ones. Try purchases, see approved charges and declines in your history to learn how it works.
A safety wall that stops any real money movement. No charges reach your bank until you intentionally connect a real provider.
coreIdeas.rememberAs: Wall stays up until you connect

coreIdeas.plainWords: Freedom to try, freeze, and learn without worry. Experiment with limits and controls to build confidence before going live.

howItWorks: Start with sample money automatically added to your demo balance
Create a capped practice card with a spend limit you choose for safe testing
Freeze, unfreeze, or close your practice card instantly with one tap
See all charges and declines clearly recorded in your sample history
Notice the test-mode banner at the top reminding you no real provider is connected yet

recallQuiz.question: Does any real money move while you are in Test Mode?
choices: Yes, all purchases charge your bank
No, only sample money is used until a real provider is connected
Yes, but only for small amounts
No, but your bank still sees the attempts
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Test Mode uses sample balance only and blocks real provider charges completely.

recallQuiz.question: What happens when you freeze a practice card?
choices: All future purchases are declined until you unfreeze it
Your sample balance is reset to zero
Real money is refunded to your bank
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Freeze instantly blocks spending without deleting the card or balance.

recallQuiz.question: Why does Test Mode show sample history with charges and declines?
choices: To practice reading charges and learning how approvals work safely
To confuse you before real use
To send data to your bank
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: Sample history lets you learn the flow safely before using real money.

recallQuiz.question: How can you tell you are still in Test Mode?
choices: A clear test-mode banner is shown on your Dashboard
You receive an email every minute
Your bank app shows a warning
recallQuiz.whyCorrect: The banner reminds you that you are in demo and no real provider is connected.

safetyNote: This is demo only. All practice data is row-level-secured private data, shown with a calm mobile-first design, and contains no real payment fields. No real money moves until you choose to connect a real provider.
tryIt: On the Dashboard, tap Add sample money to top up your sample balance, then create a practice card and tap Freeze to see purchases decline instantly.
